verdict.rationale: The only evidence that touches this story is hands-on: one user describes Authy's iOS app as 'a scrolling icon list', which implies service icons exist. The same user says finding codes is tedious beyond about 3 services, and another user complains that there is no alphabetization. Vendor docs mention only editing accounts, with no search, folders, groups or sorting. Missing for 10: documented search, folders/groups, sorting/alphabetization, first-party documentation of service icons, and evidence that the right code is quickly reachable among dozens of tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: a scrolling icon list and 10pt service names make finding codes tedious with more than ~3 services
